stemMarkdown: In a race of 200 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 8:3. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 200 m, B covers $\dfrac{3}{8} \times 200 = 75.00$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 200 - 75.00 = 125.00$ m.
